slots.title: Want to Referee? Start at the Club
slots.summary: Moved off the lead (Morris Cup leads, Frank 2026-10-26); stays on page 1. Desk draft (271 words) from USA Fencing's become-a-referee page and the Regional Tournament Requirements 2026–28 PDF: start at the club, study guide + seminar + online exam (90%) for a P rating, then a practical exam for L/R ratings; ages 13+ with a P can work regionals; paid for more than one pool round; membership and (18+) background check/SafeSport. Ends with Friday open bouting as a place to start. Unvetted until you Vet it.
